changelog: Embedded public release update endpoint internally (hidden from frontend UI).
Added 60-minute background auto-update checker with 3-second new update popup and manual Check for Updates button.
Guaranteed per-device private watch history and watchlist isolation across unlimited concurrent devices.
Includes Android 15 edge-to-edge top bar fix, dedicated Servers menu tab, and all 4 BDIX server fixes.
